verdict: Paid ads remain off; your Google listing activity has softened this week.
narrative: Paid advertising on Meta and Google has been inactive for the full reporting period, so your Google Business Profile is the only channel generating engagement right now — 55 total actions over the last 28 days. GBP activity fell 38% in the most recent seven days, and the last three days recorded no actions at all, which is a confirmed step down rather than normal fluctuation. On a more positive note, website sessions rose about 15% week-over-week, suggesting some organic search traffic is still reaching your site even as GBP slows. The immediate focus is stabilising GBP visibility and determining the path to reactivating paid channels so leads are flowing again.
